arxiv-2101-06184.title: Temporal-Relational CrossTransformers for Few-Shot Action Recognition
arxiv-2101-06184.creator: Toby Perrett, Alessandro Masullo, Tilo Burghardt, Majid Mirmehdi, Dima Damen, <first>.<last>@bristol.ac.uk Department of Computer Science, University of Bristol, UK
arxiv-2101-06184.description: Abstract We propose a novel approach to few-shot action recognition, finding temporally-corresponding frame tuples between the query and videos in the support set. Distinct from previous few-shot works, we construct class prototypes using the CrossTransformer attention mechanism to observe relevant sub-sequences of all support videos, rather than using class averages or single best matches.

arxiv-2102-11965.title: Modular Design Patterns for Hybrid Learning and Reasoning Systems: a taxonomy, patterns and use cases
arxiv-2102-11965.creator: Michael van Bekkum[1], Maaike de Boer[1], Frank van Harmelen [2], André Meyer-Vitali[1], Annette ten Teije [2]
arxiv-2102-11965.description: Abstract The unification of statistical (data-driven) and symbolic (knowledge-driven) methods is widely recognised as one of the key challenges of modern AI. Recent years have seen large number of publications on such hybrid neuro-symbolic AI systems. That rapidly growing literature is highly diverse and mostly empirical, and is lacking a unifying view of the large variety of these hybrid systems.

arxiv-2110-02623.title: Is An Image Worth Five Sentences? A New Look into Semantics for Image-Text Matching
arxiv-2110-02623.creator: Ali Furkan Biten Andres Mafla Lluis Gomez Dimosthenis Karatzas
arxiv-2110-02623.description: Abstract The task of image-text matching aims to map representations from different modalities into a common joint visual-textual embedding. However, the most widely used datasets for this task, MSCOCO and Flickr30K, are actually image captioning datasets that offer a very limited set of relationships between images and sentences in their ground-truth annotations.

arxiv-2208-02717.title: Searches for additional Higgs bosons and for vector leptoquarks in \PGt ​ \PGt \PGt\PGt final states in proton-proton collisions at s = 13 ​ \TeV \sqrt{s}=13\TeV
arxiv-2208-02717.description: Abstract Three searches are presented for signatures of physics beyond the standard model (SM) in \PGt ​ \PGt \PGt\PGt final states in proton-proton collisions at the LHC, using a data sample collected with the CMS detector at s = 13 ​ \TeV \sqrt{s}=13\TeV , corresponding to an integrated luminosity of 138 \fbinv .

arxiv-2211-05358.title: Multi-criticality and long-range effects in non-Hermitian topological models
arxiv-2211-05358.creator: Y R Kartik, Sujit Sarkar
arxiv-2211-05358.description: Abstract Long-range effects induce some interesting behavior and considered as a gateway to understand the non-local behavior in the quantum systems. Especially, the long-range topological models became a platform for the realization of new quasi-particles, which are believed to be potential candidates for the topological qubits.

arxiv-2308-11648.title: A Regularized ( X ​ P ) 2 (XP)^{2} Model
arxiv-2308-11648.creator: Yu-Qi Chen, Zhao-Feng Ge
arxiv-2308-11648.description: Abstract We investigate a dynamic model described by the classical Hamiltonian H ⁡ ( x , p ) = ( x 2 + a 2 ) ​ ( p 2 + a 2 ) H(x,p)=(x^{2}+a^{2})(p^{2}+a^{2}) , where a 2 > 0 a^{2}>0 , in classical, semi-classical, and quantum mechanics.

arxiv-2403-19558.title: Experimental determination of effective light transport properties in fully anisotropic media
arxiv-2403-19558.creator: Ernesto Pini, Peter Naglič, Miran Bürmen, Alexander Gatto, Henrik Schäfer, Diederik S. Wiersma, Lorenzo Pattelli
arxiv-2403-19558.description: Abstract Structurally anisotropic materials are ubiquitous in several application fields, yet their accurate optical characterization remains challenging due to the lack of general models linking their scattering coefficients to the macroscopic transport observables, and the need to combine multiple measurements to retrieve their direction-dependent values.

arxiv-2407-18214.title: Interaction of driven “cold” electron plasma wave with thermal bulk mediated by spatial ion inhomogeneity Journal: Phys. Scr.
arxiv-2407-18214.creator: Sanjeev Kumar Pandey, Rajaraman Ganesh
arxiv-2407-18214.description: Abstract Using high resolution Vlasov - Poisson simulations, evolution of driven “cold” electron plasma wave (EPW) in the presence of stationary inhomogeneous background of ions is studied. Mode coupling dynamics between “cold” EPW with phase velocity v ϕ v_{\phi} greater than thermal velocity i.

arxiv-2411-08948.title: Thermal Pseudo-Entropy
arxiv-2411-08948.creator: Pawel Caputa, Bowen Chen, Tadashi Takayanagi, Takashi Tsuda
arxiv-2411-08948.description: Abstract In this work, we develop a generalisation of the thermal entropy to complex inverse temperatures, which we call the thermal pseudo-entropy. We show that this quantity represents the pseudo-entropy of the transition matrix between Thermofield Double states at different times.

arxiv-2412-12993.title: Fourier Beyond Dispersion: Wavenumber Explicit and Precise Accuracy of FDMs for the Helmholtz Equation
arxiv-2412-12993.creator: Hui Zhang *
arxiv-2412-12993.description: Abstract We propose a practical tool for evaluating and comparing the accuracy of FDMs for the Helmholtz equation. The tool based on Fourier analysis makes it easy to find wavenumber explicit order of convergence, and can be used for rigorous proof. It fills in the gap between the dispersion analysis and the actual error with source term.

arxiv-2506-15701.title: Compiler-R1: Towards Agentic Compiler Auto-tuning with Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2506-15701.creator: Haolin Pan , Hongyu Lin , Haoran Luo , Yang Liu, Kaichun Yao, Libo Zhang, Mingjie Xing , Yanjun Wu
arxiv-2506-15701.description: Abstract Compiler auto-tuning optimizes pass sequences to improve performance metrics such as Intermediate Representation (IR) instruction count. Although recent advances leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown promise in automating compiler tuning, two significant challenges still remain: the absence of high-quality reasoning datasets for agents training, and limited effective interactions with the compilation environment.

arxiv-2507-19223.title: Investigating the Influence of Asymmetric Errors on Retrievals of Exoplanet Transmission Spectra 2024 Investigating the Influence of Asymmetric Errors on Retrievals of Exoplanet Transmission Spectra – 5
arxiv-2507-19223.creator: Jack J. Davey, Kai Hou Yip, Quentin Changeat, Ingo P. Waldmann
arxiv-2507-19223.description: Abstract In studies of exoplanet atmospheres using transmission spectroscopy, Bayesian retrievals are the most popular form of analysis. In these procedures it is common to adopt a Gaussian likelihood. However, this implicitly assumes that the upper and lower error bars on the spectral points are equal.

arxiv-2508-16210.title: Modeling User Preferences as Distributions for Optimal Transport-based Cross-domain Recommendation under Non-overlapping Settings
arxiv-2508-16210.creator: Ziyin Xiao, Toyotaro Suzumura
arxiv-2508-16210.description: Abstract Cross-Domain Recommender(CDR) Systems are designed to transfer knowledge from dense to sparse domain, alleviating data sparsity and cold-start problems in conventional single-domain recommendation methods. While many existing cross-domain methods rely on overlapping users or items to establish connections between domains, this assumption is not always satisfied in real-world recommendation systems.

arxiv-2509-00465.title: Embodied Spatial Intelligence: From 3D Perception to 3D Reasoning
arxiv-2509-00465.creator: Jiading Fang

arxiv-2509-07091.title: HE2159-0551: a very metal-poor peculiar low Ba giant – a candidate from the LMS-1/Wukong
arxiv-2509-07091.creator: A. Schichtel, D. H. Plonka, C. J. Hansen
arxiv-2509-07091.description: Abstract Aims. We present a comprehensive spectroscopic and kinematic analysis of the very metal-poor ([Fe/H] = − - 2.60 ± \pm 0.20 dex) giant star HE2159-0551 . By investigating the star’s chemodynamic characteristics, we seek to address its formation, evolution, and role in the chemical enrichment of the early cosmos and the possible connection to known merger events. Methods.

arxiv-2602-10820.title: Adaptive Sampling for Private Worst-Case Group Optimization
arxiv-2602-10820.creator: Max Cairney-Leeming, Amartya Sanyal, Christoph H. Lampert
arxiv-2602-10820.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Max Cairney-Leeming, Amartya Sanyal, Christoph H. Lampert. Models trained by minimizing the average loss often fail to be accurate on small or hard-to-learn groups of the data. Various methods address this issue by optimizing a weighted objective that focuses on the worst-performing groups. However, this approach becomes problematic when learning with differential privacy, as unequal data weighting can result in inhomogeneous privacy guarantees, in particular weaker privacy for minority groups.

pmc-10577680.creator: Wen Chao, Gregory H Jones, Mitchio Okumura, Carl J Percival, Frank A F Winiberg
pmc-10577680.description: Sulfur oxide species (RSOx) play a critical role in many fields, ranging from biology to atmospheric chemistry. Chlorine-containing sulfur oxides may play a key role in sulfate aerosol formation in Venus’ cloud layer by catalyzing the oxidation of SO to SO2 via sulfinyl radicals (RSO).

pmc-10616693.title: Work, marriage and premature birth: the socio-medicalisation of pregnancy in state socialist East-Central Europe
pmc-10616693.creator: Kateřina Lišková, Natalia Jarska, Annina Gagyiova, José Luis Aguilar López-Barajas, Šárka Caitlín Rábová
pmc-10616693.description: Reproductive health in state socialism is usually viewed as an area in which the broader contexts of women’s lives were disregarded. Focusing on expert efforts to reduce premature births, we show that the social aspects of women’s lives received the most attention.

pmc-11584885.title: Crop classification in the middle reaches of the Hei River based on model transfer
pmc-11584885.creator: Huazhu Xue, Yongkang Fan, Guotao Dong, Shi He, Yaokang Lian, Wenfei Luan
pmc-11584885.description: Crop classification using remote sensing technology is highly important for monitoring agricultural resources and managing water usage, especially in water-scarce regions like the Hei River. Crop classification requires a substantial number of labeled samples, but the collection of labeled samples demands significant resources and sample data may not be available for some years.

pmc-11647377.title: What do women experiencing domestic violence expect from healthcare professionals? A qualitative study in Sri Lanka
pmc-11647377.creator: Tharuka Silva, Abey Rathnayake, Maggie Evans, Duleeka Knipe, Thilini Rajapakse, Thilini Agampodi
pmc-11647377.description: ObjectivesFor healthcare professionals (HCPs) to provide optimal support for women experiencing domestic violence (DV), it is important to understand what type of support women expect from HCPs. The objective of this study was to explore what kind of support women who experienced DV in Sri Lanka expect from HCPs.DesignA qualitative descriptive design was used.

pmc-11650355.title: Development of a new Peyronie’s disease self-assessment screening app
pmc-11650355.creator: Gregory A Broderick, Jesse N Mills, Lisa Bathish, Christopher Davis, Mohit Khera
pmc-11650355.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Peyronie’s disease (PD) is an underdiagnosed and undertreated fibroproliferative disorder associated with the formation of plaques that results in penile curvature and discourages some men from seeking medical consultation. The PD self-assessment app, a digital application (app), was developed to increase PD awareness, provide men with a self-screening and educational tool for PD, and help eliminate barriers to seeking consultation with a physician. Prior to deployment, 4 board-certified urologists provided qualitative reviews on the app’s usability and utility as a screening tool.

pmc-11675383.title: What’s the Matter? Alcohol Use Risk Among Relatives of People with Mental Illness
pmc-11675383.creator: Suzanne A. McKeag, Gordon L. Flett, Joel O. Goldberg
pmc-11675383.description: Family members who live with relatives with serious mental illness face unique mental health risks, which become worse with alcohol use and without social support. Research has highlighted the damaging effects of harmful substance use among people who feel like they do not matter to others, but few studies have assessed links between mattering and alcohol use within marginalized populations.

pmc-12766219.title: Restitution or substitution after loss of a human hand: A personal view
pmc-12766219.creator: Simon PJ Kay
pmc-12766219.description: The author summarises the differences between prosthetic care and allotransplantation in managing upper limb loss.Keywords: Upper limb, Prosthesis, Amputtaion, Allotransplantation of upper limb, Hand transplant In 2010, a group of surgeons in Leeds,1 prompted by colleagues in solid organ transplantation, began the process of building support for the establishment of a hand transplantation service.

pmc-12927478.title: Visualized analysis of core themes and emerging frontiers in global chikungunya virus studies
pmc-12927478.creator: Jing Tian, Yonggang Li, Yuanlong Zhao, Xiaoli Tao
pmc-12927478.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). pmc-12958380.title: Letter to Editor regarding ‘Variants in the interferon regulatory factor 5 gene confer genetic risk for systemic lupus erythematosus in a Han Chinese population’
pmc-12958380.creator: Aditya K Panda, Sharda Sharma
pmc-12958380.description: d relevance of IRF5 in the pathogenesis of SLE. The authors reported an association between two functional variants (rs10954213 and rs2004640) and SLE susceptibility in the Chinese population. Although this study contributes useful data from a Northern Han Chinese cohort, several methodological and interpretational issues merit clarification.

pmc-13045021.title: Atomic Building Blocks of Global Buildings
pmc-13045021.creator: Jonathan M. Broyles, Matt A. Jungclaus, Danielle N. Beatty, Wil V. Srubar III
pmc-13045021.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Buildings require vast quantities of materials and natural resources. Quantifying and understanding the composition of whole buildings is necessary to support circular economies that mitigate the future environmental impacts of the built environment. An understanding of the chemical composition of buildings can support urban mining efforts for resource management and elemental recovery in addition to furthering the knowledge of the carbon storage potential of buildings.

pmc-13302999.title: Duration of Spent Mushroom Substrate Return Affects Microbial Assembly and Nitrogen Metabolism to Promote Functional Stabilization in Rice–Mushroom Crop Rotation Systems
pmc-13302999.creator: Yihong Yue, Yu Jiang, Yuchen Zhang, Tingting Xiao, Haibo Hao, Qian Wang, Zongjun Tong, Jinjing Zhang, Hui Chen
pmc-13302999.description: Spent mushroom substrate (SMS) return is a vital strategy for agricultural waste recycling and soil fertility improvement, yet its ecological impacts of duration remain poorly understood. This study employed metagenomic sequencing to explore soil fertility, microbial dynamics, and nitrogen cycling across different SMS return durations (0, 1, and 3 years) within rice–mushroom crop rotation systems.
